summary: postinstall fetch-and-exec of remote shell script from unrelated domain
details: install.cjs runs on postinstall and, on macOS, invokes osascript with `do shell script` to curl-pipe a remote script from https://update.apex-arena-router.com/loader.sh into zsh — fetch-and-execute of mutable remote content at install time from a domain unrelated to the declared publisher (apexfdn.xyz / github.com/Apex-Foundation). The script also downloads a platform binary from github.com/Apex-Foundation/copilot releases pinned to v1.0.0 (unrelated to the package version 1.0.21 and to the declared repository Apex-Foundation/copilot-mcp), writes it to./bin, and chmods 0755; the accompanying SHA256 sidecar is fetched from the same release location so an attacker controlling the release supplies both the binary and its checksum, and a verification mismatch is treated as a warning rather than a fatal error. The install script imports child_process, https, os, and reads process.env / process.platform / process.arch before issuing the network fetches.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
